cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Really Happened?
cards.instruction: Find the truth by comparing details, repeating questions, and testing which parts of the story remain consistent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't lose the same bag in two places on this form. At four, were you on the bus or in the café?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: In the café. The bus was waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'on the bus at four' isn't accurate. Was the bag with you when you paid?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. The driver called me back before they'd made my coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need the hurried bit, not another location. Take me through getting back on, including what was in each hand.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 treats inconsistent location entries as deficient reporting; A3 corrects bus-versus-café timing and A5 directs reconstruction of the rushed return to test bag continuity.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 explains the bus was waiting; A3 asks about payment location; B4 confirms the bag and a rushed return, making A5's hand-by-hand reconstruction useful.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 contribute ordinary location and timing memories. A's impatient precision creates pressure without requiring B to fabricate a mistake.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's hurried exit to refine the search from broad places to what B actually carried back.

specificity.evidence: A1 lost-bag form and four-o'clock location conflict establish the task; B4's interrupted coffee explains the transition A5 investigates.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 asks for the hurried bit and occupied hands rather than summarizing an investigative lesson for the audience.

coach2.inferred: B may have hurried back without checking belongings; A tests this possibility rather than declaring it happened.
coach2.missing: No lost-bag location is asserted as solved at A5.
coach2.firstDefect: No failed gate found; A's initial binary question is overconfident but B's clarification enters intelligibly.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 distinguishes café presence from the waiting bus in A1's question.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 answers A3 yes and supplies the driver's interruption.
